items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: I’m working with a band now, George Gee, and it’s been together for about fifteen years.

ctx.x: To keep anybody together, to gel.

Yeah, right. Yeah it doesn’t happen too often anymore. I’m working with a band now, George Gee, and it’s been together for about fifteen years. I mean it’s spasmodic, you know, working here and there. But we went to Zurich and worked this past summer. And it was great.
